errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.TITLE_REQUIRED: Please give the recipe a title.
errors.ALREADY_IN_FAMILY: You're already in a family. Leave it first to join another.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Only the family's owner can do that.
errors.SECTION_EXISTS: There is already a section with that name.
errors.TOO_MANY_SECTIONS: A family can have at most 30 sections.
errors.ITEM_EXISTS: There is already an item with that name. Merge the two instead.

signIn.headline: Pick the week's dinners.
signIn.pitch: Your family's recipes, one shared menu, one list to tick off in the store.

account.deleteBody: You leave your family and your account is deleted for good. Recipes, dinners and list items you added stay for the others, without your name. If you're the only member, the family and everything in it is deleted too.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.intro: Grocr is shared by a family. Start a new one, or join the family that invited you.
welcome.createHint: You'll be the owner and can invite others
welcome.joinHint: Enter the code you were sent
welcome.next: Next: add your first three recipes so you can plan a week.

join.title: Join a family
join.intro: Type the invite code you were sent.
join.invalid: That code doesn't work. It may have been used or expired; ask for a new one.
join.rateLimited: Too many wrong codes. Try again in an hour.
join.footer: Invite codes work once and expire after 48 hours. Ask for a new one if yours has run out.

pick.title: Dinner for {{day}}
pick.noRecipes: No recipes yet. Add some on the Recipes tab.

suggest.title: Dinner ideas
suggest.intro: Favourites you have not had for a while. Swap or skip any of them.
suggest.footer: Their ingredients go on {{week}}'s grocery list.
suggest.noRecipes: Add a few recipes first, then Grocr can suggest a week.
suggest.noDays: Every day left this week already has a dinner.
suggest.someTaken_one: {{count}} day already had a dinner planned, so it was left as it was.
suggest.someTaken_other: {{count}} days already had a dinner planned, so they were left as they were.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.empty: Add your family's dinners here. With a few recipes you can plan a whole week.
recipes.archiveHint: Archived recipes stay on dinners you already planned.

rating.nobody: Nobody has rated it yet. Tap a star once you have had it.

groceries.title: Groceries
groceries.empty: Nothing on this list yet. Plan dinners on the Week tab, or add items above.
groceries.addPlaceholder: Add an item, e.g. 2 l milk
groceries.clearBody_one: {{count}} checked item will be removed from the list.
groceries.clearBody_other: {{count}} checked items will be removed from the list.
groceries.carryTitle_one: Last week's list has {{count}} unchecked item.
groceries.carryTitle_other: Last week's list has {{count}} unchecked items.
groceries.allShoppedBody: Everything on the list is in the cart or at home.
groceries.sameAsLabel: Which item is {{name}} the same as?
groceries.mergeBody: Recipes and lists that use {{from}} will use {{into}} instead, and typing “{{from}}” later finds {{into}}.
groceries.staplesBody_one: {{count}} staple isn’t on this list. Tap it to add it.
groceries.staplesBody_other: {{count}} staples aren’t on this list. Tap one to add it.
groceries.newSince_one: {{count}} new item since you last looked
groceries.newSince_other: {{count}} new items since you last looked

family.title: Family
family.makeOwnerBody: They'll manage members and invites. You stay in the family as a member.
family.removeBody: They lose access to the family's recipes, menu and lists.
family.leaveBody: You'll lose access to its recipes, menu and lists. You can join again with a new invite.
family.leaveLastBody: You're the last member, so the family and all its recipes, menus and lists will be deleted.
family.name: Family name

invite.title: Invite to {{family}}
invite.intro: Send the code to someone in your family. They sign in to Grocr, tap "I have an invite" and type it.
invite.shareMessage:
Join {{family}} on Grocr to plan dinners and share the grocery list. Your invite code: {{code}}
https://grocr.io/join/{{code}}
invite.factExpiry: Works once and expires in 48 hours.
invite.factMembers: You'll see who joined on the Family tab and can remove them.
invite.factEdit: New members can edit recipes, the week menu and grocery lists.

storeOrder.title: Sections
storeOrder.intro: Put the sections in the order you walk through your store. The grocery list follows it. Tap a section to rename or delete it.
storeOrder.jevNote: Grocr sorts items into your sections by itself, including ones you add. Moving an item yourself always wins.
storeOrder.deleteBody: Its items are sorted into your other sections, or Other if nothing fits.
storeOrder.otherStays: Items that fit nowhere else go here, so this section can’t be deleted.

loop.title: Welcome to Grocr
loop.body: Dinner planning in three steps: save your recipes, put them on the week, and the grocery list fills itself.

recipes.title: Save the dinners you love
recipes.body: Add your family's recipes under Recipes, with the ingredients for each. You only type them once.

week.title: Plan the week
week.body: On Week, tap a day and pick a dinner. From Friday it opens on next week, ready for the weekend shop.

groceries.title: The list writes itself
groceries.body: Every planned dinner puts its ingredients on Groceries, added up and sorted the way you walk the store. Tick things off as you shop.

family.title: Plan and shop together
family.body: Everyone in the family shares the same week and list, and sees changes right away. Invite them from the Family tab, where you'll also find this tour again.

items.title: Items
items.intro: Everything your family has added to recipes and grocery lists. Tap an item to rename it, move it to another section, or merge it with one that is the same thing.
items.empty: No items yet. They show up here as you add recipes and groceries.
items.takenBody: Merge them, so recipes and lists use one item?

staples.title: Staples
staples.intro: Things you buy most weeks, like milk, bread or coffee. Every week’s grocery list offers the ones that aren’t on it yet.
staples.empty: No staples yet. Add some below, or long-press an item on the grocery list and pick “Buy every week”.

whatsNew.title: What's new
whatsNew.sheetIntro: A few things got better since you last looked.
whatsNew.intro: What has changed in Grocr lately, newest first.

darkMode.title: Dark mode
darkMode.body: Grocr follows your phone's light or dark setting. To choose one yourself, go to Family › Appearance.

atHome.title: Already at home
atHome.body: Tap the house on a grocery item you already have. It moves out of the way, so nobody buys it twice.

items.title: Tidy up your items
items.body: Family › Items lists everything your family has added. Rename an item, move it to another section, or merge two that are the same thing.

staples.title: Staples
staples.body: Mark the things you buy every week, like milk or coffee. Each week's list offers the ones that aren't on it yet.

typeAhead.title: Suggestions as you type
typeAhead.body: Start typing on the grocery list and Grocr suggests items your family already uses, so milk stays one item.

ratings.title: Rate your dinners
ratings.body: Give a recipe one to five stars after you've had it. The recipe shows the family's rating and when you last made it.

dinnerIdeas.title: Dinner ideas
dinnerIdeas.body: Short on ideas? On Week, Grocr can suggest dinners for the empty days: favourites you haven't had in a while. Swap or skip any of them.

newSince.title: New since you last looked
newSince.body: Items someone else put on the grocery list since you last opened it are marked New, so you see at once what was added.
